snippet.title: Aground Zero 1.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
Aground Zero is finally leaving Early Access on April 4th, 2025! It's amazing how far we've come in the year since we entered Early Access - there's now online multiplayer, space stations and planets to travel to, and two endings!

I hope you're getting excited for the launch - there's a lot you can do and build in Aground Zero, and already I've seen some wild player saves with huge factories and moon bases!

Get Aground Zero on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1795570/Aground_Zero/
